subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'later'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1 is: **later**.
 
• Explanation: In the context provided, the sentence is discussing **the founding of Kala Bhavan, an art school, in 1919.** It then goes on to mention that** this school later became a part of the Visvabharati University, founded in 1921**. The word "**later**" indicates a sequence of events, implying that** the establishment of Kala Bhavan** preceded its incorporation into** Visvabharati University.**
 
• Meanings of the other options:
 
 
• **better** - This word does not fit the context of the sentence, which is discussing the chronology of events rather than evaluating their quality.
 
• **faster** - This word does not convey the idea of sequential timing as required by the sentence.
 
• **slower** - This word does not convey the idea of sequential timing as required by the sentence.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**later**," as it accurately reflects the temporal relationship between the establishment of** Kala Bhavan and its integration into Visvabharati University. **

 

**Correct Passage:__** *Rabindranath Tagore founded a small school at Santiniketan in 1901 and Kala Bhavan, an art school, in 1919 which **later** became a part of the Visvabharati University founded in 1921. Located in an (2)________ village some distance from the city of Calcutta, Kala Bhavan presented an alternative methodology of art training, in which studio based practice was (3)________ in favour of learning through observation and living as a part of nature. The natural surroundings with the (4)________ of bare red earth dotted with trees, the colours of the changing seasons, the animals and birds (5)________ inspiration to students.*
